about: Rung pricing on the feed's build rate and the shelf's live auctions, server and browser on the same passes. `rows` are the feed's pass rows (three shaped on the live probe of 2026-11-18, names as labels, ids made up), `as_of` the snapshot's moment (10 minutes after the shelves were read), `otd` what the server serves for them (advisor/snapshot.py _otd_json, without picks and starters), `rules` and `budgets` as served. `expect.passes` is what both sides must find for each pass: its build rate, its rungs' costs, and the cards on sale toward Common and Rare; `expect.pass_deals` the pass deals each level finds with its default budget, nothing held, every sport.

why.nba:2027:player:9001: Wembanyama NBA 2027 as the feed will send it: build cell common 5-7 at 30.36 (11 sales), the shelf's live auctions paying 38 to 60 a point, all firm (read 10 min ago, each ending within 2 h; one already over). No pass deal: nothing on the shelf is under the build rate.
why.nba:2027:player:9002: The same pass as served today: no new fields, traded rate 38.46, a shelf of 40 and 50 floor openings (about 9 a point). The old maths calls it a pass deal; kept as the contrast.
why.nfl:2024:player:9003: Gibbs NFL 2024: traded rate 164.38 carried by Mystic sales; the build cell is legendary 7+ at 29.17 (7 sales). Its only listing, a Mystic at 25,000, ends in 34 h: an opening, parked over 5x the build rate anyway.
why.nhl:2023:player:9004: Matthews NHL 2023: build cell uncommon 5-7 at 20.34; accepted offers clear near 30 a point, above listings; its three listings end in about 6 h: openings.
why.mlb:2025:player:9005: Measured by bucket and rarity, but no cell has 5 listing sales: the traded rate 22.0 stands in, thin; no pass deal may rest on it.
why.nba:2025:player:9006: A row without the new fields: priced and served exactly as before.
why.nhl:2025:player:9007: A pass deal the new maths finds and the old would not: three firm auctions (ending within 2 h) add 10 rating for 156, 15.6 a point against a build rate of 20; a cheaper card ending in 25 h is only an opening and is left out; the old shelf's targets, 40 a point, were dearer than the traded 30.
